1.On February 14, 2025, the Company had allotted 18,86,793 equity shares on preferential basis to promoter / promoter group of the Company, which are under lock in and also allotted 78,80,436 warrants, each convertible into one equity share, on preferential basis to non-promoter investors (Issue 1). Further, the Board of Directors of the Company have approved, the forfeiture of 1,12,578 warrants convertible into equity shares of the Company, which were allotted on February 14, 2025 on a preferential basis, due to non-payment of the balance amount payable towards conversion of the said warrants within the stipulated period.

2.Details of holding of shares/ warrants of partnership firms (who were allotted warrants and equity shares under preferential issues) are shown under category "Resident Individual holding nominal share capital upto Rs. 2 lakhs", as per the information received from depositories.

3.The Company has on July 30, 2026 done the allotment of 12,52,629 equity shares upon conversion of warrants into equity shares which have been shown in physical form, as the process for crediting these shares in demat account of allottees could not be completed due to pending corporate action process at the Stock Exchanges and depositories as on September 30, 2026

4.The Company has on August 14, 2026 done the allotment of 53,38,840 equity shares upon conversion of warrants into equity shares which have been shown in physical form, as the process for crediting these shares in demat account of allottees could not be completed due to pending corporate action process at the Stock Exchanges and depositories as on September 30, 2026.

5.Details shown in column holding exercise of right of the SBO in the reporting company whether direct or indirect shows indirect holding of SBOs. For direct holding of SBOs please refer serial no. A1a of table II of shareholding pattern.
6.Shares under Category Public includes 4,73,244 fully paid up equity shares held in the Unclaimed suspense account and 26,75,160 fully paid up equity Shares held by IEPF Authority on which voting rights are frozen.

7.For disclosure of approved limits in Annexure B we have considered limits provided in sectoral statutory cap prescribed by Regulatory Authorities.
